title: Home practical guide and safety card: quadrat survey
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Ecosystems (7D); atoms, elements and molecules (7H)
source: Written for science/y7 lesson 64 (Home practical guide and safety card: quadrat survey (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 64: Ecosystems in action: a home habitat survey. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To estimate a plant population using a quadrat
equipment: Four rulers, sticks or string to make a 50 cm square (0.25 m²)
safety: An adult is with you outside
Stay away from roads and water
Do not touch nettles, fungi or animal waste
An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Make a 50 cm by 50 cm quadrat
Measure the area of the lawn or grass (length × width, in m²)
Throw a soft object over your shoulder and place the quadrat where it lands (random)
Count one plant species inside it, such as daisies
Work out the mean per quadrat, then × 4 for per m², then × the area

questions.q: A square frame for sampling is a...
Big question: how could you estimate daisies on a field?
questions.a: Count in random quadrats, find the mean and scale up to the area.
